rows.grounds: epithet or deity name; feminine nominative singular
demonstrative pronoun referring to enumerated deities

items.question: What identity and radiance characterize the concluding deities in this directional enumeration?
premises: The deity Anaṅgamālinī is named in this enumeration.
The particle hi emphasizes the stated identification.
These deities possess radiance like bandhūka flowers.
items.inference: The concluding deities of the sequence are identified as Anaṅgamālinī, radiant like bandhūka flowers.
uncertainties: Whether etāḥ refers only to Anaṅgamālinī or collectively includes previously named deities.
items.plain_english: Indeed these are Anaṅgamālinī, radiant like bandhūka flowers.
